description: Java source code defining a custom typed aggregation in Apache Spark, including classes for Employee, Average, and MyAverage, with a main method demonstrating usage with a JSON dataset.

classes.name: JavaUserDefinedTypedAggregation
classes.description: Main class demonstrating custom aggregation in Spark with nested classes for Employee, Average, and MyAverage.

classes.name: JavaUserDefinedTypedAggregation.Employee
classes.description: Serializable class representing an employee with name and salary fields.

classes.name: JavaUserDefinedTypedAggregation.Average
classes.description: Serializable class used as an intermediate buffer for the custom aggregation, holding sum and count.

classes.name: JavaUserDefinedTypedAggregation.MyAverage
classes.description: Custom Spark Aggregator class computing the average salary from Employee objects.

methods.name: zero
methods.description: Returns the initial zero value for the aggregation.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Combines an Employee object into the buffer, updating sum and count.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges two buffer objects into one.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Computes the final average salary from the buffer.

methods.name: bufferEncoder
methods.description: Provides the encoder for the buffer type.

methods.name: outputEncoder
methods.description: Provides the encoder for the output type.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method initializing Spark session, reading data, performing aggregation, and displaying results.
